name: Transco Leidy Southeast Expansion Project
researcher_notes: Not an existing row. Roster has Leidy South (P2551, 12.2 mi, a different project) and other Transco expansion rows (P3201, P7108, P7792, P2544) but none for docket CP13-551. Passes the add threshold: sponsor Transco, endpoints Monroe and Luzerne Counties in Pennsylvania to Mercer, Somerset and Hunterdon Counties in New Jersey, and the project was built. New pipe is 29.8 miles (about 48 km) of 42-inch loop in four segments, above the 25 km minimum. The FERC environmental assessment of 2014 for docket CP13-551 states 29.8 miles, 42-inch loops, 525,000 dekatherms per day, a planned in-service date of December 2015, and names Transco. The EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 814, lists Leidy Southeast Expansion: Completed, in service 2015, 30 miles, 42 inches, 525 MMcf/d added, cost 610 million dollars, docket CP13-551. EIA is one origin and the FERC assessment is another. The EIA row lists states PA, MD, VA, but the loops are only in PA and NJ; the other states had compressor and meter station work, which adds no pipe. Length uses the FERC figure of 29.8 miles over EIA's rounded 30. The Federal Register notice URL from the queue failed the verifier and is not cited. Route not researched here; no official GIS found yet, so no route. Owner spelled as on the existing Transco rows. Parent not filled as no ref was checked. ProposalYear not filled because no filing date was checked.
